# Parallel options

<!-- GENERATED by tests/ArcaneCore.World.Tests/Docs (ConfigReferenceRenderer.RenderByArea) from the options classes. Do not edit by hand.
     Regenerate: ARCANECORE_UPDATE_DOCS=1 dotnet test tests/ArcaneCore.World.Tests --filter Docs -->

8 options. Set them in the daemon's `.conf` file or `appsettings.json`. Full reference: [configuration.md](../configuration.md). All areas: [index](README.md).

Daemon says which server reads it. Reload says whether `.reload config` applies it: `live` is applied to the running server, `restart` keeps its value until the next start, `start` is read once when the daemon starts.

## `World`

| Option | Type | Default | Allowed | Daemon | Reload | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `Parallel:BotThinkPerMap` | `bool` | `false` | true \| false | World | restart | Run the bots' thinks per map, on the map's update thread, as a stage after the map's other updaters and before Output (`MapBotThinkStage`; docs/research/map-local-stages-design-20261024.md, section 5.7), instead of in the playerbot feature's own pass (default false: today's order, exactly). With it on, the playerbot feature does its movement pump, intake and coordinators before the maps, each map thinks for the bots standing on it inside its update, and the feature closes the tick after the maps (the bots on no map, or on a map whose stage did not run, are thought for then, on the world thread). The tick's think time and actions are split between the maps by head count; each map's share is measured on its own thread, so with parallel maps the shares overlap and the phase takes about the longest share, not their sum. The stage always runs inside the serial gate: `Ungated` naming MapBotThinkStage is ignored until bot actions have the per-session queue of design 3.4. Needs a restart. |
| `Parallel:CreatureSplinePass` | `bool` | `false` | true \| false | World | restart | Split each creature update into a spline pass (every active living creature's spline advanced and relocated, map-local work) and the rest (AI, leash, generators, respawns), instead of one pass that does both per creature (default false). With CreatureMapSystem in `Ungated` the spline pass runs outside the serial gate and the rest inside it, one gate entry per stage; a relocation that changes cell still takes the gate (grid loads). The order changes for every thread count alike: a creature's AI sees the other creatures of its map already moved this tick. |
| `Parallel:GateAllStages` | `bool` | `false` | true \| false | World | restart | With `MapUpdateThreads` above 1, run every stage of every map update inside the serial gate, even the ones classified map-local (default false). The workers and the barrier still run; nothing runs concurrently. A switch to tell a race in a map-local stage from a problem of the parallel machinery itself. |
| `Parallel:Gated` | `string` | `""` | text | World | restart | Map-update stages or updater type names to run inside the serial gate although the code classifies them map-local (default empty). |
| `Parallel:MapHelpers` | `int` | `0` | a whole number, -2147483648 to 2147483647 | World | restart | Helper threads a map thread may lend to the data-parallel stages inside one map update (`MapLocalStage `; docs/research/map-local-stages-design-20261024.md, section 4.3 and wave 6a), 0..64 (default 0: every stage runs on the map's own thread, in today's order). A stage computes per-item results (helpers may share this work, results land in per-item slots) and then applies them on the map thread in item order, so the outcome is the same at every helper count. Needs a restart. |
| `Parallel:MapUpdateThreads` | `int` | `1` | a whole number, -2147483648 to 2147483647 | World | restart | Threads that update maps during the maps phase, the world thread included (default 1: today's serial loop, exactly). With 2 or more, maps (continents, instances, battlegrounds) are updated concurrently, one thread per map at a time; map work that is not classified as map-local runs inside the world's serial gate, and the tick continues only when every map is done. 1..64. |
| `Parallel:OwnerGuard` | `OwnerGuardMode` | `Report` | Off \| Report \| Throw | World | restart | What a change to a map's state from a thread that does not own it does while maps update in parallel (default Report). Off with `MapUpdateThreads` 1, where only the world thread runs. Values: `Off`, `Report`, `Throw`. |
| `Parallel:Ungated` | `string` | `""` | text | World | restart | Map-update stages (Packets, Heartbeat, ActiveCells, Output, Grid, Deferred) or updater type names (CreatureMapSystem, …) to run outside the serial gate although the code does not classify them map-local, comma-separated (default empty). An experiment switch for finding what still races; a stage that is not map-local can corrupt shared state when ungated. |
